interventions.speaker: CHAIR
interventions.who: the senior urologist who signs the decision
interventions.body: The prognosis is influenced by several factors, including the preoperative PSA of 6.4 and the pathological findings showing a Gleason 3+5 (ISUP grade group 4) with pT3a extraprostatic extension. Negative surgical margins and no seminal vesicle invasion are favorable elements. A significant limitation is that no lymph nodes were removed, meaning nodal status cannot be assessed, which widens uncertainty. The biopsy-to-prostatectomy comparison shows concordance in the Gleason pattern (3+5/group 4). Prognostic revision would benefit significantly from postoperative PSA measurements and tracking its subsequent trajectory. The current data lacks information regarding any prior recurrence events or detailed follow-up history to refine risk stratification beyond the established parameters. The fixed estimated horizon is 56.82 months. This represents expected follow-up without an event, not a known recurrence date. The sensitivity range is 36.93–76.70 months; its coverage has not been validated.
